div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p: Post-award reporting / compliance check

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
What does the award require —
and on what cadence?
(read the terms: monthly / quarterly /
semi-annual / annual / final)

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;
display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
PROGRAMMATIC / performance report
outcomes vs. the proposed objectives
(write it results-forward — see the
reporting-as-cultivation best practice)

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p: Is a report deadline within ~30 days?

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Are the data and the budget-vs-actual
already current (tracked monthly)?

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
CALENDAR it now with a lead-time buffer
schedule the data pull + draft + internal review
before the funder deadline

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
DRAFT and submit early;
keep the submission confirmation in the file

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
FIX THE TRACKING CADENCE
monthly budget-vs-actual, not report-time reconstruction
(see the budget-vs-actual best practice)

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
AUDIT TRIGGER CHECK —
did the org expend ≥ the federal
Single Audit threshold in FEDERAL awards
this fiscal year?
[verify-at-use 2026-06-22 — threshold set by 2 CFR 200
and has been raised by amendment]

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
SINGLE AUDIT required (2 CFR 200 Subpart F)
engage an auditor; assemble the SEFA
(Schedule of Expenditures of Federal Awards);
confirm the current threshold + deadline

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Other audit / monitoring trigger?
(funder-required audit, prior findings,
high-risk designation, subrecipient status)

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
PREPARE for the funder/pass-through monitoring
document trail must be retrieval-ready

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Stay AUDIT-READY anyway
(document trail + reconciled ledger at all times)
